verdict.rationale: Moneybird is an accounting SaaS that ships a CLI and an MCP server, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no mention of telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Token revocation and scoped API tokens are access controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
